videos.title: St. Louis Night Sky: Orion’s Belt & Sirius Brightening the Haze 🌌
videos.description:
Catching Orion’s Belt rising in the early morning sky! 🌌

If you look down and to the lower left, that brilliant point of light following Orion's Belt isn't Jupiter—it's Sirius (the Dog Star), the brightest star in the night sky. You can even see the lingering St. Louis humidity giving the atmosphere that distinct glow.

videos.description:

Notice the subtle movement in the air—that soft, swirling haze is classic St. Louis humidity forming a thin layer of night fog, catching the low light as moisture suspended in the air drifts past.
